compute.note: Both scientific queues reached 12 concurrent fit callbacks. Callback CPU includes reuse, inference and fitting; optimizer-only CPU was not measured. execution.note: This observed exit 2 denotes partial scientific-program status. The saved run has zero operationally failed executions and zero failed fits. Earlier work remains preserved; publication adds no owner fits or source requests.
execution.summary: The five-framework extension completed. Source, frontier-feature, benchmark and publication requirements still keep the full scientific program partial.

findings: All 9 primary objective leaders change from the preceding market study after the five-framework extension. Their identities are selected only on the two validation seasons.

The new primary leaders have worse 2026 test results on 8 of 9 objectives and better results on 1. This diagnostic comparison does not alter the validation-selected leaders or define the next research campaign.
For the selected winner model family, calibration worsens equal-year validation log loss from 0.505068 raw to 0.507276 calibrated. Raw and calibrated policies remain separate candidates.
The comparison preserves 109 earlier no-market controls and the prior source-ablation study. Nonlinear source ablations, broader interactions and validated blends remain separately registered work.
Removing all market sources from the selected winner-Brier model changes its validation Brier score from 0.169317 to 0.183500. The missing-source stress keeps every completed game in the denominator.

prepared.summary: A finite 936-job campaign and 84 fixed-blend recipes are prepared around registered source and feature gaps. Completed work is recovered first. No owner research has been launched by this preparation, and 2026 outcomes do not choose the campaign.
